source_excerpts.text:
FULL ENTROPY WITNESSES ON ONE DEPENDENT STATIONARY RECORD
Solo construction, 31 October 2026. Priority unestablished.

1. THE OBJECT AND THE NEW QUESTION

Keep the exact contract of predictive_flow/PROOF.txt: stationary discrete-time
Markov dynamics on a standard-Borel hidden space, finite observed alphabet,
and ordinary ALL-EVEN reversal. Reducible and periodic models are allowed.
For Gamma=pi P, cost e=D(Gamma||Gamma^T). Realised path entropy is

 Sigma_N=log[dP_path/dP_path^R](X_0,...,X_N).

It is random and may be negative. A stationary mean rate is a different
target. No mixing time, hidden count, independent repeats or acquired
stationary marginal is supplied. Hidden stationary initialization remains
an external premise. The global mean-rate obstruction N185 is preserved.

The previous reversible-dual construction detected zero cost, and the
previous current construction attained full path-rate recovery on a special
family. Here the object is the FULL entropy dual. The main transfer below
converts every finite entropy witness into a finite-confidence realised-path
bound. Section 7 uses the complete predictive-flow hierarchy to identify
the least hidden dissipation compatible with a stationary ERGODIC observed
law, using a single record. It has no useful uniform computation budget.

2. THE POINTWISE ENTROPY-WITNESS CONE

Define phi(t)=2t atanh t on (-1,1), phi(0)=0, with the extended endpoint
values +infinity, and phi*(h)=sup_t[ht-phi(t)]. For an edge payoff H(x,y),
write H_s=(H(x,y)+H(y,x))/2 and H_a=(H(x,y)-H(y,x))/2. Require

                    H_s+phi*(H_a)<=0                      (E1)

pointwise. Equivalently a H(x,y)+b H(y,x) is at most
a log(a/b)+b log(b/a) for all nonnegative a,b. Diagonal payoffs must be
nonpositive. The cone is convex: H_s is affine and phi* convex.

For any stationary flow, E_Gamma H<=e(P). Indeed, relative to
eta=(Gamma+Gamma^T)/2 let t=(dGamma-dGamma^T)/(dGamma+dGamma^T). Then
e=E_eta phi(t), while E_Gamma H=E_eta[H_s+t H_a]. Fenchel proves the
claim, including zero/infinite cases. This expectation inequality alone
would not justify inference from dependent finite data.

3. THE REALISED-ENTROPY EXPONENTIAL TRANSFER

Suppose (E1), H bounded and |H_a|<=M. For 0<theta<=1/2,

 E_P exp{theta[sum_{t<N}H(X_t,X_{t+1})-Sigma_N]}
                                      <=exp(N theta^2 M^2/2).             (E2)

Proof. The positive tilt
